label: GO after an unrewarded trial, strongly choosing a2, mid-episode (trials ~10-70)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.7% of mass, never with reward input 1), and only when the policy strongly favours a2 (choice logit < -4.4; ~100% of activations have model_act = a2, mostly staying on a2 after an a2 trial). On top of that it has a strong episode-time dependence: almost silent in trials 0-9 and after trial ~70, peak at trials 30-59. These conditions are close to necessary (dev mass recall 0.99) but not sufficient: precision is only ~0.3, and no observed-history refinement I tried (prev transition, two unrewarded trials in a row, the value band) raised F1 above ~0.49, so what decides which qualifying GO steps fire is not captured. Activation tends to build over consecutive unrewarded a2 trials in the examples, but I did not verify that as a magnitude rule. Never fires at D1 or D2, after rewarded trials, or when choosing a1. Uses only observed variables plus the agent own policy logit.
